description: Ships NO CODE. Declares the Desert Ant Labs Uhm ONNX artifact and one model-runtime recipe, so the host's declarative lane registers detect_fillers from data alone.

tools.name: detect_fillers
tools.description: Find every uh, um, hmm and filler 'and' in a recording and return the millisecond spans to cut, with honest coverage.

skills.name: detect-fillers
skills.description: Use detect_fillers to find filler words and hesitations in spoken audio before cutting or captioning it.
